## Research need
REC-HISTORY has a completed local boundary and actual-input inventory. A specified Bianchi characteristic/frame connection was still needed, and matching physical history uncertainty remains open. The recovered HISTORY02 Stage A contained a construction without implemented adapter or primary raw results.

## Result and implementation
REC-HISTORY-02R is COMPLETE_SCOPED_CHARACTERISTIC_ADAPTER, PASS_SCOPED. The separate unit preserves the original Stage A owner, reservation and historical budgets.
- Implement a unique retarded source event for positive-rate constant-shear Bianchi I, source direction and source-owned tangent.
- Convert the native Wien departure reference before calling the unchanged HISTORY01 boundary; retain the single-event number/energy ledger.
- Reject unsupported retained prefixes/endpoints and nonfinite or nonsmooth fixed-cell tangents before the legacy thermal fallback.
- Supply a conditional uncertainty transfer requiring actual input/tube bounds. Actual physical history uncertainty remains unadmitted.

## Validation
Frozen primary: 127 rows / 776 named numerical comparisons, PASS. Independent oracle: mpmath 80 digits; one independent review pass: 6 rows / 10 adapter entries, PASS_SCOPED. First import failure and environment repair are preserved. Original two figures and repaired two figures were actually reviewed; the repair changed presentation only.
New local combined CPU 6.394983 s, execution wall 14.087619764017768 s, peak 97252 KiB, within 30/90 s and 1 thread. New IVP, native recombination runtime, dense RHS and old campaign replay are all zero.
S1 frozen code/cases: 49610577fb53940db120fa8b6d8ee4f29198d1a2.
S2 original primary raw: ca73220a4ac2293c32fb8057fe26faf19227ef12.
S3 final science/evidence: 4224a7be162c70e1cef222afaa546af7b4e2cd8a; changed blobs 83/83 readback PASS.
The subsequent delivery-only commit changes receipts/report/handoff metadata, not science, code or raw data.

## Publication and backups
S0/S1/S2A/S2/S3 were published and independently read back; Dropbox completed ACK and current metadata confirmed for all five immutable checkpoints.
S3 archive: SHA256 83198452157b9360b10d59c0df4ef1e1eccbfa5aaa52bf73ec6e886f8e482aae, 2187080 bytes, Dropbox id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_9HA / rev 65e8da9d9926f0af03d47. Local payload 189/189 and ZIP CRC 190 members PASS; immediate remote whole-byte GET NOT_RUN.
Drive S0 UNKNOWN_ACK_NOT_RECEIVED; later NOT_ATTEMPTED_PROVIDER_STALLED. Dual-provider delivery remains partial.
Central additive observation: https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/pull/224, commit f0a92c2421ff186dabd20fac09378a97c195fd4f. Exact two-file readback and independent static review PASS, preserving all 40 contracts, 17 edges and other owners' latest states.

## Repository CI and physical limits
Complete-log correction: S3 verify-durable-backup runs 40058413072 / 40058409067 failed the committed-feature whitespace gate; the complete inspected S3 job log reports 78 distinct paths, including 21 in this unit with new blank lines at EOF. The earlier 26-path / zero-new-unit count came from an incomplete log selection and is superseded, with its original record preserved. The metadata commit 3848a94ccd5910d8fe48890d4a980bf5efb678ee also failed the same gate (PR run 40059205644, inspected job 120768837109: 78 paths / 21 in this unit). Setup/import smoke passed; pytest was skipped. Repository-wide CI PASS is not claimed; finite scientific evidence remains separate. Frozen contracts, source snapshots and historical evidence have not been rewritten for whitespace. No manual workflow rerun or scientific replay was performed.
Actual h4 data are retained and eight queries within their own early domain pass arithmetic comparison. At the inherited z≈1100 face the h4 candidates cover 0/313; the h2 U5 covering 313/313 has different physical parameters. Independent endpoint/reference/M2 uncertainty remains missing.
Parent REC-HISTORY PARTIAL; H5 INPUT_DEPENDENT_UNCALIBRATED. Angular supplier/measure/quadrature and full thermodynamic Jacobian remain open. ADM01 original detailed raw preservation remains PARTIAL_AFTER_WORKSPACE_RESET.
Physical HOLD; U5 HOLD_9_FAIL/HOLD_8_FAIL; CLOSED_HOLD_NOT_RESET; global_convergence NOT_RUN; production NOT_APPROVED; REI_activation=false; first failed REI raw HISTORICAL_LOCAL_ONLY. Draft only; no merge or activation.
